patterns.intent: Distribución por año y serie
patterns.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM FECHA) AS ANO, SERIE, COUNT(*) AS N, CAST(SUM(IMPORTETOTAL) AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS TOTAL_EUR FROM DOCCAB WHERE TIPO = 0 AND FECHA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM FECHA), SERIE ORDER BY ANO DESC, N DESC

patterns.intent: Presupuestos vs clientes únicos
patterns.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_PRESUPUESTOS, COUNT(DISTINCT CODCLIENTE) AS CLIENTES_DISTINTOS, CAST(COUNT(*) AS NUMERIC(15,2)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CODCLIENTE), 0) AS PRESUPUESTOS_POR_CLIENTE FROM DOCCAB WHERE TIPO = 0

patterns.intent: Distribución de ESTADOPEND en presupuestos (estado real)
patterns.sql: SELECT ESTADOPEND, COUNT(*) AS N FROM DOCCAB WHERE TIPO = 0 GROUP BY ESTADOPEND ORDER BY N DESC

patterns.intent: Presupuestos aceptados por tipo de documento destino (factura/pedido)
patterns.sql: SELECT d.TIPO AS TIPO_DESTINO, COUNT(DISTINCT dd.CODDOCUMENTO) AS N_PRESUPUESTOS FROM DOCDESTINO dd JOIN DOCCAB c ON c.CODIGO = dd.CODDOCUMENTO AND c.TIPO = 0 JOIN DOCCAB d ON d.CODIGO = dd.CODDOCUMENTODESTINO GROUP BY d.TIPO ORDER BY N_PRESUPUESTOS DESC

patterns.intent: Total presupuestos con cualquier documento destino vinculado
patterns.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CODIGO) AS TOTAL_PRESUPUESTOS, COUNT(DISTINCT dd.CODDOCUMENTO) AS CON_DESTINO, COUNT(DISTINCT c.CODIGO) - COUNT(DISTINCT dd.CODDOCUMENTO) AS SIN_DESTINO FROM DOCCAB c LEFT JOIN DOCDESTINO dd ON dd.CODDOCUMENTO = c.CODIGO WHERE c.TIPO = 0

patterns.intent: Columnas de DOCCAB que contienen ESTADO o ACEPTA (metadatos BD)
patterns.sql: SELECT FIRST 20 RDB$FIELD_NAME FROM RDB$RELATION_FIELDS WHERE RDB$RELATION_NAME = 'DOCCAB' AND (UPPER(RDB$FIELD_NAME) LIKE '%ESTADO%' OR UPPER(RDB$FIELD_NAME) LIKE '%ACEPTA%' OR UPPER(RDB$FIELD_NAME) LIKE '%SEGUIM%' OR UPPER(RDB$FIELD_NAME) LIKE '%RESULT%') ORDER BY RDB$FIELD_POSITION

patterns.intent: Identificar TIPO correcto para SAT/garantía (distribución real)
patterns.sql: SELECT TIPO, SERIE, COUNT(*) AS N, CAST(SUM(IMPORTETOTAL) AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS TOTAL_EUR FROM DOCCAB WHERE UPPER(SERIE) LIKE UPPER('%SAT%') OR UPPER(SERIE) LIKE UPPER('%GAR%') OR UPPER(SERIE) LIKE UPPER('%TEC%') GROUP BY TIPO, SERIE ORDER BY N DESC

patterns.intent: Datos SAT reales (TIPO=2, serie SAT)
patterns.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM FECHA) AS ANO, SERIE, COUNT(*) AS N, CAST(SUM(IMPORTETOTAL) AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS TOTAL_EUR FROM DOCCAB WHERE TIPO = 2 AND FECHA IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM FECHA) <= 2026 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM FECHA), SERIE ORDER BY ANO DESC, N DESC

patterns.intent: Contar el número total de presupuestos enviados en 2026
patterns.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CODIGO) AS TOTAL_PRESUPUESTOS_ENVIADOS_2026 FROM DOCCAB c WHERE c.TIPO = 0 AND c.FECHA >= '2026-01-01' AND c.FECHA < '2027-01-01' AND c.CODCLIENTE IS NOT NULL

patterns.intent: Contar cuántos presupuestos fueron aceptados en 2026
patterns.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dd.CODDOCUMENTO) AS PRESUPUESTOS_ACEPTADOS_2026 FROM DOCDESTINO dd JOIN DOCCAB c ON c.CODIGO = dd.CODDOCUMENTO WHERE c.TIPO = 0 AND c.FECHA >= '2026-01-01' AND c.FECHA < '2027-01-01' AND c.CODCLIENTE IS NOT NULL

patterns.intent: Analizar la distribución temporal de presupuestos en 2026 por mes
patterns.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c.FECHA) AS MES, COUNT(DISTINCT c.CODIGO) AS TOTAL_PRESUPUESTOS, COUNT(DISTINCT dd.CODDOCUMENTO) AS ACEPTADOS, CAST((COUNT(DISTINCT dd.CODDOCUMENTO) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CODIGO)) AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS TASA_EXITO FROM DOCCAB c LEFT JOIN DOCDESTINO dd ON dd.CODDOCUMENTO = c.CODIGO WHERE c.TIPO = 0 AND c.FECHA >= '2026-01-01' AND c.FECHA < '2027-01-01' AND c.CODCLIENTE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c.FECHA) ORDER BY MES

patterns.intent: Evaluar la calidad de los datos en 2026, identificando nulos y vacíos en CODCLIENTE
patterns.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CODIGO) AS TOTAL_PRESUPUESTOS, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.CODCLIENTE IS NULL THEN c.CODIGO END) AS PRESUPUESTOS_CON_CLIENTE_NULO, CAST((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.CODCLIENTE IS NULL THEN c.CODIGO END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CODIGO)) AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS PORCENTAJE_NULOS_CLIENTE FROM DOCCAB c WHERE c.TIPO = 0 AND c.FECHA >= '2026-01-01' AND c.FECHA < '2027-01-01'

patterns.intent: Datos REALES (años <= 2026, excluyendo futuros)
patterns.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM FECHA) AS ANO, SERIE, COUNT(*) AS N, CAST(SUM(IMPORTETOTAL) AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS TOTAL_EUR FROM DOCCAB WHERE FECHA IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM FECHA) <= 2026 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM FECHA) >= 2016 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM FECHA), SERIE ORDER BY ANO DESC, N DESC
